title: Large-run output profile (opt-in streaming exporter for full-size native triangular runs)

native_nc_face_chunk.description: faces per NetCDF chunk; time chunk is always 1

display_grid_cell_size_m.description: m; derived legacy display grid spacing (not the computing mesh)

display_grid_anchor_x_m.description: m; lower-left cell-edge anchor A_x (historical 50 m grid)

stepjson_min_depth_m.description: m; a record is written iff depth > value (legacy rule: > 0)

write_stepjson_native.description: also write stepjson_native/ keyed by exact native face_id

write_geojson.description: also write faces.geojson (same features, attributes and coordinates) inside every SHP package, in the same export step

shp_wet_depth_threshold_m.description: m; MAXIMUM_WET_SURFACE threshold; null = run dry_depth_threshold_m

disk_safety_factor.description: free bytes must be >= estimate * factor

socio_exposure.description: optional socio-economic exposure overlay (docs/socio_exposure_overlay.md); null = not read

gate_log.description: optional gate dispatch LOG (gate_dispatch.csv/json + gate_discharge_hourly.csv); log only, gate opening does not affect the computation; null = not written

ledger_xlsx.description: dispatch ledger workbook (.xlsx, needs openpyxl); relative paths resolve against the driver config; null = MODEL rows only

actions_sheet.description: sheet with 日期/时刻/调度对象/调度动作 columns

inventory_sheet.description: sheet with 工程名称/孔数 (bay counts for opening ratios)

ledger_utc_offset.description: UTC offset of the ledger clock times

boundary_gates.description: boundary group (section key) -> gate_id; one MODEL record series per entry

prescribed_change_min_m3_s.description: m3/s; prescribed-discharge steps smaller than this are not logged

grid_cells_path.description: polygon shapefile of 50 m grid cells (grid_cells_socio.shp); .shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj required

population_field.description: persons per cell (>= 0, no missing values)

district_code_field.description: district code; null = no per-district split

district_totals_csv.description: CSV qu_dm,population,area_km2,arable_km2 (context: share of district inside the domain)

district_grid_summary_csv.description: CSV 区代码,区名,网格数,面积_km2,网格内常住人口_合计,网格内耕地_亩_合计 (read cross-check)

exposure_depth_threshold_m.description: m; a face is exposed iff its depth >= value

depth_class_edges_m.description: m, strictly increasing; classes [e_k, e_k+1) and [e_last, inf)

mapping_cache_dir.description: directory for the reusable face mapping npz keyed by mesh fingerprint + source digest

conservation_rel_tol.description: relative tolerance of the area/value conservation checks
